apk.permissionsExpl: These permissions are requested in the APK's manifest and can be abused to steal banking credentials, intercept OTPs, or access personal data without your awareness:
apk.loopholesExpl: We extracted and analyzed the legal terms and privacy strings inside this APK. The following loopholes and predatory clauses were found that can exploit users under Indian law:
apk.whatToDoNow: What should you do right now?
apk.step1Desc: If already installed, turn off Wi-Fi/Mobile Data, go to Settings -> Apps and uninstall this application immediately.
apk.step2Desc: Check Settings -> Accessibility on Android to ensure this app does not have background control of your screen.
apk.step3Desc: Log in to your bank app directly to verify no unauthorized debit or collect requests occurred.
apk.step4Desc: Dial 1930 immediately to freeze fraudulent transfers within the golden hour.

BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE.name: Accessibility Service (Keylogger & Remote Control)
BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE.description: Can read everything on your screen, record keystrokes, and automatically click buttons.
BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE.abuse_scenario: Scammers and banking trojans use this to steal your UPI PIN and Netbanking passwords as you type them.

RECEIVE_SMS.name: Receive SMS (OTP Interception)
RECEIVE_SMS.description: Allows the app to intercept incoming SMS messages before you even see them.
RECEIVE_SMS.abuse_scenario: Fraudulent banking APKs use this to secretly intercept your bank OTP and authorize unauthorized money transfers.

READ_SMS.name: Read SMS Messages
READ_SMS.description: Can read all your personal and banking SMS messages.
READ_SMS.abuse_scenario: Used to monitor your bank balances, UPI transaction alerts, and private verification codes.

SEND_SMS.name: Send SMS in Background
SEND_SMS.description: Can send outgoing SMS from your SIM card without prompting you.
SEND_SMS.abuse_scenario: Used to send paid premium SMS or register your phone number on malicious services.

SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.name: Display Over Other Apps (Fake Screen Overlay)
SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.description: Can draw fake windows and login screens on top of genuine apps.
SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.abuse_scenario: Draws a realistic fake State Bank of India or UPI login screen over your genuine app to harvest your credentials.

READ_CONTACTS.name: Read Full Contacts List
READ_CONTACTS.description: Uploads all your friends, family, and colleagues' phone numbers to remote servers.
READ_CONTACTS.abuse_scenario: Rogue instant loan apps use this to blackmail you by calling and threatening your family members.

READ_CALL_LOG.name: Read Call Logs
READ_CALL_LOG.description: Monitors who you speak with and how often.
READ_CALL_LOG.abuse_scenario: Used by predatory loan collectors to map out your closest friends and relatives for harassment.

REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES.name: Install Other Unknown APKs (Dropper)
REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES.description: Can download and install secondary malware packages in the background.
REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES.abuse_scenario: Acts as a Trojan dropper that pulls in additional spy tools or spyware without your consent.

RECORD_AUDIO.name: Record Audio / Microphone
RECORD_AUDIO.description: Can activate the microphone to listen in on surrounding conversations.

CAMERA.name: Access Camera
CAMERA.abuse_scenario: Can take background snapshots without triggering visible camera previews.

CONTACT_HARASSMENT.title: Contact List Harassment & Third-Party Shaming Loophole
CONTACT_HARASSMENT.explanation: The fine print claims you authorize the lender to contact everyone in your phonebook, including your relatives and employer, to publicly shame you and demand debt recovery.

HIDDEN_FEES.title: Unilateral Hidden Processing Fees & Auto-Debit Trap
HIDDEN_FEES.explanation: Contains clauses permitting arbitrary daily interest rates (up to 300% APR), hidden processing fees deducted upfront, and recurring bank account auto-debits without separate OTP authorizations.

DISPUTE_WAIVER.title: Banking Ombudsman & Legal Dispute Forfeiture Clause
DISPUTE_WAIVER.explanation: Attempts to strip your statutory rights to file a fraud dispute with your bank, report to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Banking Ombudsman, or approach Indian consumer courts.

GALLERY_SCRAPING.title: Private Media & Gallery Scraping Clause
GALLERY_SCRAPING.explanation: The agreement states that personal photos, selfies, and stored device media may be uploaded to remote servers under the guise of 'credit score evaluation' or 'identity verification'.

DATA_SALE.title: Sale of Personal & Financial Data to Recovery Firms
DATA_SALE.explanation: Permits the unrestricted sale and monetization of your banking SMS history, phonebook, and identity documents to unregulated third-party collection agencies.

ELECTRICITY_BILL.title: Electricity Disconnection Phishing Trap
ELECTRICITY_BILL.tip1: Verify your Consumer ID (CA Number) on your physical paper bill or official state DISCOM portal (e.g. BESCOM, BSES, Mahavitaran, WBSEDCL, TANGEDCO).
ELECTRICITY_BILL.tip2: State electricity boards NEVER send disconnection notices from personal 10-digit mobile numbers or collect bill dues via personal UPI.
ELECTRICITY_BILL.tip3: Never install screen-sharing apps like AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or QuickSupport if instructed by callers to 'update bill status'.

FAKE_KYC.title: Bank Impersonation & KYC Suspension Scam
FAKE_KYC.tip1: Real Indian banks never send SMS with clickable links ending in .xyz, .site, or .top to update PAN or KYC.
FAKE_KYC.tip2: Never enter your NetBanking username, password, ATM PIN, or card CVV on unverified web forms.
FAKE_KYC.tip3: If you submitted details, immediately lock your NetBanking profile via your bank's app and hotlist your debit/credit card.

FAKE_BANK_LINK.title: Counterfeit Banking Portal Detected
FAKE_BANK_LINK.tip1: Examine the web address: genuine bank websites end in official domains like .bank.sbi or official .com/.co.in portals.
FAKE_BANK_LINK.tip2: Immediately freeze your netbanking access and call your bank's 24x7 emergency card-blocking helpline if credentials were submitted.
FAKE_BANK_LINK.tip3: Banks will never ask you to re-verify your debit card PIN or NetBanking credentials through external web pages.

UPI_COLLECT_FRAUD.title: UPI Outgoing Collect / Reverse Payment Scam
UPI_COLLECT_FRAUD.tip1: UPI PIN is ONLY entered to DEBIT/SEND money from your account. You NEVER enter a PIN to receive payments or cashback.
UPI_COLLECT_FRAUD.tip2: Open your UPI app (Google Pay / PhonePe / Paytm / BHIM) -> Go to Pending Requests -> tap DECLINE and BLOCK.
UPI_COLLECT_FRAUD.tip3: If money was debited, call 1930 immediately to freeze the recipient bank account within the 2-hour golden period.

MALICIOUS_QR.title: Malicious Payment QR Code Trap
MALICIOUS_QR.tip1: QR codes in UPI are designed strictly to SEND money out. Scanning a QR code will never deposit money into your account.
MALICIOUS_QR.tip2: Do not scan the QR code. If already scanned, immediately cancel the transaction before entering your UPI PIN.
MALICIOUS_QR.tip3: If you entered your PIN and money was debited, dial 1930 and contact your bank to report the fraudulent UPI UTR.

PARCEL_DELIVERY.title: India Post & Courier Impersonation Scam
PARCEL_DELIVERY.tip1: India Post and genuine courier services never demand ₹5–₹25 redelivery fees via SMS links.
PARCEL_DELIVERY.tip2: Track your consignment only on official portals (e.g., indiapost.gov.in) using your 13-character tracking number.
PARCEL_DELIVERY.tip3: Scammers use nominal ₹10 fees to capture full 16-digit card numbers, CVVs, and OTPs for larger subsequent debits.

JOB_SCAM.title: Part-Time Task & Prepaid Investment Fraud
JOB_SCAM.tip1: No genuine company pays ₹2,000–₹5,000 daily for liking YouTube videos, rating hotels, or following social profiles.
JOB_SCAM.tip2: Never pay 'prepaid task fees', 'tax clearance', or 'VIP unlock fees' to withdraw virtual dashboard balances.
JOB_SCAM.tip3: Exit and report the Telegram / WhatsApp group immediately. Block all contact with the group admins.

LOTTERY_PRIZE.title: KBC / Fake Prize & Lottery Extortion
LOTTERY_PRIZE.tip1: You cannot win a lottery or prize draw you never purchased a ticket for or entered.
LOTTERY_PRIZE.tip2: Never pay advance 'GST', 'customs charges', or 'processing fees' to claim any prize.
LOTTERY_PRIZE.tip3: Ignore forged letters with RBI, Ministry of Finance, or celebrity photos—they are fabricated by cybercrime syndicates.

OTHER.title: Suspicious Message & Urgency Alert
OTHER.tip1: Scammers create artificial urgency ('account closed tonight', 'immediate action required') to prevent you from consulting family.
OTHER.tip2: Always verify unsolicited claims by independently looking up the company's official customer support number.
OTHER.tip3: Talk to your family or call 1930 if you feel pressured or doubtful about any message.
